content.short: A zero-to-one DEX protocol that runs within a single smart contract to maximize gas efficiency and liquidity.
content.description:
Ambient Finance is a decentralized exchange protocol that operates entirely within a single smart contract, significantly reducing gas costs and liquidity fragmentation. It uniquely combines "ambient" (constant-product) and "concentrated" liquidity in a single pool, offering a more efficient trading experience. The protocol features "Knockout Liquidity," a specialized limit order tool that prevents orders from reversing once a target price is hit.

Ambient also supports automated fee reinvestment and gasless transactions via EIP-712 standards. This allows users to pay fees in the tokens they are swapping, providing a seamless and professional-grade experience for DeFi traders and liquidity providers alike.
